name: forensic-monorepo
description: Forensic monorepo: iOS app (ios/), Fastify server (server/), React web app (web/), shared TS schema (packages/shared/).

scripts.test: pnpm parity && pnpm --filter @forensic/server test && pnpm --filter @forensic/web test

pnpm.//: pnpm 9 disables lifecycle scripts of deps by default. Whitelist puppeteer so its postinstall actually downloads Chromium during `pnpm install`. Without this Render deploys land without a Chrome binary and PDF export fails at runtime with 'Could not find Chrome' (Build #5.66.1).
